variants.title: 01 · 중장갑 작업 슈트
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: refined HEX BLADE thick-armored HUMAN-WORN POWERED SUIT landscape concept sheet.
Input image 1 = current human-fit design sheet EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 = originally approved cream/sage A mech sheet, reference for substantial chunky armor and game identity.
USER CORRECTION: current three suits went too light, too much ordinary fabric/workwear. Make this design feel like a substantial ARMORED MACHINE SUIT again, with visibly THICK armor. Preserve that one adult human wears it. Do not simply show a face on the original autonomous robot. Balance compact mechanical mass and human body fit.
Change this sheet: replace thin shoulder/upper chest/forearm/shin plates with thick angular multi-plane shells about 1.5-2x current armor depth. Deep bevel sidewalls, wide layered plate rims, real robust corner thickness, obvious graphite inner supports and recessed seams. Large solid CREAM shoulder caps close above actual human shoulders, hefty compact segmented chest shells, thick SAGE outer upper arm/thigh/shin shells, CREAM reinforcement ends. Dense broad human-worn gauntlets around real gloved hands, reinforced broad industrial boots housing real feet. Increase shoulder and forearm volume, lower-leg mass, torso front-to-back protection; armor should visually occupy about 75-80% of the body surface while dark ribbed fabric remains at neck, narrow waist and joint flexures. Retain short sturdy mechanical assist links and a compact substantial backpack at human back height.
CRITICAL human-worn rules: same full size adult face visible within main hero helmet (raised visor or translucent amber glass as appropriate), recognizable real neck and waist, real human elbow/knee/wrist axes. Fit about 6-head armored proportions, compact sturdy limbs, not tall thin fashion model. Armor grows OUTWARDS around the human, do not shorten or relocate their limbs. Glove fingers human-sized relative to wearer, no giant robot hand or disconnected joystick-driven limbs. Boots protect human feet with a thick sole, not giant feet far beyond the toes. No cockpit, no miniature pilot, no piston neck.
Keep exact cream/sage/graphite/amber/mint/red-sword identity, bold dark indigo outlines and clean large cel planes. Strong machine-like visual heft but body can bend its fabric waist/elbow/knee, don't fill joints with solid armor. No photorealism, no metallic micro-greebles, no rusty worn texture, no rifles, shields or new weapons.
Redraw ALL views in this SAME current sheet consistently with the new thickness: primary full-body 3/4 hero, front/back, side human-fit overlay, helmet inset, two action poses. Preserve landscape 3:2 composition, warm paper/mint accents, readable short Korean panel labels, boots within frame. Use only short useful design labels and no slogans/marketing copy or measurements. The anatomy/overlay should fit throughout the chunky shells, not only a pilot chest.

Specific variant 01 HEAVY FIELD SHELL: make the original A cream angular broad shoulders and chunky chest protection the clearest visual influence. Broad compact cream chest breastplate split into upper and lower sliding blocks; substantial sage arms and thighs with exposed fabric only at joint bends; thick cream-rim sage forearm shells. Strong industrial machine silhouette, big clean beveled surfaces. Preserve raised amber visor and visible wearer face. Main standing pose no rifle. Front/rear keep low compact twin-block battery. Panel title exact "01 · 중장갑 작업 슈트".
